purpose: independent generic CUDA launch and stream synchronization diagnostics; no LLM or fitted timing input

resources.stream: one cudaStreamNonBlocking, created before any warmup
resources.events: two cudaEventDefault timing events, created before any warmup and reused only after completion
resources.memory: one 8192-byte device buffer and one pinned host buffer allocated before warmup

measurement.host_enqueue_call_total: sum of disjoint per-launch call intervals only
measurement.host_enqueue_envelope: first launch begin to last launch end; includes earlier syncs in stream_sync_each mode
measurement.host_sync_call_total: sum of disjoint per-launch sync and final stream-sync intervals
measurement.total_wall: start-event-record begin to final-sync end; includes event APIs and observation overhead
measurement.cuda_event_span: elapsed device-event span on one stream; may include host-supply gaps and is NOT pure kernel-time sum
measurement.interval_combination: do not add enclosing or overlapping intervals; never add CUDA span to host wall or host enqueue envelope to sync totals

checks.output: all 2048 words checked after every warmup/formal burst; low-load per-invocation output plus untouched sentinel
checks.cuda_api: record integer CUDA statuses, post-sync event queries, elapsed-time status and launch error; any error invalidates run
checks.identity: source, protocol, binary, compiler hashes plus fresh GPU UUID/CC/SM and driver/runtime versions; fail before timing if known identities disagree

predeclared_variability_gate.failure_policy: retain all raw rows and report unstable or observer_limited; no outlier deletion, retry cherry-picking, averaging across modes, or automatic profile update

transferability.candidate_promotion: requires separately predeclared transfer validation on independent kernels/streams/supply patterns before explicit bottom-level parameter candidate
forbidden: event_span / burst claimed as pure kernel cost
unresolved: empty-kernel launch differs from parameter-heavy real operators
CPU scheduling/WDDM/driver queue depth affect host durations
stream_sync_each changes synchronization and overlap policy

execution_gate.precondition: R5/R6 simulator processes and unrelated GPU/CPU benchmark work idle; clocks and native DLLs unchanged
